card.fires_on: The word "of" after "risk" or "evidence", and "acute" in "hyperacute" or after "risk of", in transplant and graft-versus-host disease passages.

modes.label: "of" after risk/evidence
modes.description: The linking word "of" right after "risk" or "evidence", before a transplant or rejection term.
modes.example: increases the risk<< of>> acute rejection.

modes.label: "acute" in transplant terms
modes.description: The word "acute" in "hyperacute" GVHD, or after "risk of" before rejection.

card.plain: It fires on small words like "of" and "acute" just before transplant rejection or graft disease is named.
